description: This file defines a PHP class 'Ip' within the OpenCart framework. The class handles fraud detection based on IP address, providing methods to check if an order's IP is associated with known fraudulent IPs and to retrieve IP details from the database.

classes.name: Ip
classes.description: A model class used for IP-based fraud detection within the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks whether the IP address associated with an order is flagged for fraud, returning the corresponding order status ID if flagged, or 0 otherwise.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves IP information from the database for a given IP address.
